name: ha-home-panel
description: A wall-tablet and phone dashboard for Home Assistant, installed as a custom sidebar panel

scripts.test:visual:docker: npm run build && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots=all
scripts.test:visual:container: npm run build && container run --rm --init -c 4 -m 4g -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual
scripts.test:visual:update:container: npm run build && container run --rm --init -c 4 -m 4g -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots=all
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --check dist/home-panel.js
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && prettier --write package.json README.md examples/configuration.yaml
